title: Operators [Comparison & Logic]
description:
## Comparison Operators
- `==` equal
- `!=` not equal
- `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`

## Logic Operators
- `&&` AND
- `||` OR
- `!` NOT

```qc
int x = 10;
println(x > 5 && x < 20);  // true
println(!(x > 100));        // true
```
